name: Route Mobile Ltd
title: Route Mobile Ltd - 543228 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Route Mobile's FY26 revenue fell 3.7% to ₹4,408 crore while gross margin rose to 22.9% as low-margin ILD exited; FY27 guide of mid-to-high single-digit growth and ~12% EBITDA margin shows no supply-side signal.

capex.quote: the organic CapEx is not signiﬁcant, as you've seen in the past also

triggers.label: Revenue per transaction 29 → 25 paisa
triggers.quote: revenue per billable transaction fell from twenty-nine paisa to twenty-ﬁve paisa

triggers.label: Dividend ₹11 → ₹16.5/share
triggers.quote: Our regular dividend will meaningfully increase from INR 11 per share to a sustainable level of INR 16.5 per share

triggers.label: ILD stabilising at bottom
triggers.quote: we have kind of seen that stabilizing now

triggers.label: WhatsApp pricing revised lower
triggers.quote: the pricing on WhatsApp itself was revised during the year. So that is where the realizations went low

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to grow by mid to high single digits
we will deliver the expected increase in revenue while achieving an EBITDA margin of around 12%

red_flags.label: Revenue down 3.7% FY26; ILD 1/4–1/3 of revenue still declining
red_flags.quote: it is around one-fourth to one-third of our revenue somewhere in that range

red_flags.label: Cash ~₹1,400 cr with low yield; capital allocation unclear
red_flags.quote: we will review our cash balances and optimize them in the coming quarters

red_flags.label: Guidance first time; no clear FY27 pricing assumption
red_flags.quote: we do not expect a dramatic shift upwards in the unit pricing or unit realizations

evasions.quote: Just give us a moment. I mean, we can do this. I mean, can we take this offline.

evasions.topic: New products revenue breakup / Network API and Firewall contribution
evasions.quote: unfortunately, we don't disclose that in the public domain
unfortunately, I'm not able to give you an exact breakdown of product- wise margin at this point
we will deﬁnitely share updates in the coming quarters what are we doing in cash
